summary: Avalon at Mission Bay III, an AvalonBay apartment community whose grand opening AvalonBay announced on June 18, 2009.

milestones.text: Opened: AvalonBay's June 18, 2009 release says it "today is celebrating the grand opening of Avalon at Mission Bay III".
DBI recorded new-construction permit 200105300277 (17 stories, 260 dwellings, 353/383 King St) as completed. This is the permit's closure date, not an opening date.

open_questions: This record was created on 2026-09-27 to carry Pier & Point's own field photos. Its summary is limited to what its cited source confirmed when re-read that day; fuller details recorded elsewhere in Pier & Point's data (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.

DBI lists the new-construction permit under block 8705, lot 002; this record's parcel is 8705/006 (later permits at the same addresses use lot 006). The permit closed on Aug 14, 2009, about two months after the June 18, 2009 grand-opening release. These are two different kinds of date: the opening is the status change, the permit closure is a separate fact.
